name: Orendil's Cure
summary: In Ashenvale, Orendil's Cure is bound for a sick child in Astranaar. Orendil Broadleaf sends an Alliance traveler with a remedy made from rare flora.

sections.title: A Father's Despair
sections.body: In Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon watches his daughter Relara waste away from a severe, mysterious sickness. With local knowledge exhausted, he sought help from herbalists across Ashenvale before hope faded.

sections.title: A Race Across the Woodlands
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf brews a draught to halt Relara's affliction from the necessary components, including Bathran's hair. He entrusts the cure to you and sends you south and east along the forest highway to Astranaar, where Relara awaits it.

sections.title: A Fragile Respite
sections.body: Orendil's draught brings Relara relief, but it cannot end the supernatural malady gnawing at her spirit. The remedy buys time for a search among ancient Kaldorei ruins for relics blessed by Elune, which may complete her salvation.

faq.answer: Relara Whitemoon, Pelturas Whitemoon's young daughter, is bedridden in Astranaar. Her condition is critical, and her father is desperate to find a remedy.
Orendil Broadleaf, a night elf herbalist in northern Ashenvale, brewed the mixture after receiving plant matter gathered from Bathran's Haunt.
Pelturas Whitemoon lives in Astranaar, the Alliance town on the main road through central Ashenvale. He watches over his daughter's sickbed inside one of the woodland dwellings.

faq.q: Does Orendil's Cure completely heal Relara?
faq.answer: No. The draught stabilizes Relara's immediate condition and gives her father renewed hope, but her sickness needs deeper spiritual help. Travelers search for Elune's Tear.

faq.q: What ingredients were used to create this cure?
faq.answer: Bathran's hair was the primary ingredient, gathered from the cursed ground of Bathran's Haunt north of Maestra's Post.

faq.q: Why didn't Astranaar's local healers brew the cure themselves?
faq.answer: Relara's affliction resisted Astranaar's everyday remedies, so Pelturas sought Orendil Broadleaf's specialized botanical expertise. Orendil knows how to handle the potent flora of northern Ashenvale.

angles.text: Herbalism shows how botany meets battlefield medicine: harvested Ashenvale herbs such as Bathran's hair can hold a child's life in the balance.
As a night elf, you help protect Astranaar's young and strengthen your people's community in a contested forest.
As a priest, you know herbs can ease Relara's body for a time, while her lingering malady calls for Elune's sacred intervention and lunar rites.
